text:
Priya_CS: MintWave onboarding: APAC demo tomorrow morning. Their demo traffic is tripping edge RLs in tokyo. They requested a short-lived config change (3h). Can ops handle an ephemeral boost + allowlist?
Owen_CSM: This demo ties into renewal checks. If we show lower latency it's a strong signal. Please include a quick blurb for AE about the routing tweak.
Ravi_Ops: I can do it. Plan: pin demo header flows to ap-northeast-1, add two demo IPs to ephemeral allowlist, bump burst to 1000 rps for 3h, autorevoke after 5h. Add fallback to eu-west-1 at 200ms p50.
Priya_CS: Demo clients: 192.0.2.77 and 192.0.2.78. They set header X-MW-Demo:1 on demo calls.
Tess_Engineer: Header routing supported; I'll push the rule to staging and run a smoke. ETA 20m.
Marco_SRE: Recommend KV cache pre-warm 10m before demo with small synthetic runs to avoid token cost spikes. I'll monitor p95 and abort if regression >10%.
Ravi_Ops: I'll schedule pre-warm at T-10m and apply config at demo start. Ephemeral allowlist TTL=5h so it auto-revokes.
Priya_CS: Please paste the config you'll apply so AE note can include it.
Ravi_Ops: Applying at 2024-10-15T00:00:00Z (local 09:00 JST). Snippet:
```
customer: "mintwave"
change_id: "3501239999-ephemeral"
allowlist_ips: ["192.0.2.77/32","192.0.2.78/32"]
rate_limit: {region: "ap-northeast-1", burst_rps: "1000", window_start: "2024-10-15T00:00:00Z", window_end: "2024-10-15T03:00:00Z", autorevoke_ttl: "5h"}
routing: {match_header: {name: "X-MW-Demo", value: "1"}, primary_region: "ap-northeast-1", fallback: "eu-west-1", fallback_latency_ms: "200"}
```
Tess_Engineer: Looks good. I'll post staging smoke (latency, errors, token spend) in ~20m.
Marco_SRE: I'll run pre-warm and set alerting for token cost + p95. If p95 increases >10% we rollback and notify.
deploy-bot: change_request mintwave-3501239999 queued for manual approval by Ravi_Ops at 2024-10-14T23:40:00Z
Ravi_Ops: Approved. Pre-warm scheduled 23:50 UTC, apply at 00:00 UTC. I'll update thread with smoke results and revoke timestamp when done.
Owen_CSM: I'll add a note to renewal tracker: "MintWave APAC demo with ephemeral rlift; positive result could materially reduce renewal risk."
Priya_CS: Thanks team  please @channel any major regressions. I'll collect MintWave PM feedback after demo and drop follow-up notes here.
